summary: Historical final acceptance failed on FA-001 through FA-003. The audit correctly blocked production acceptance because authentic owner-event provenance was not wired, reviewer isolation lacked the then-required proof, and exact raw snapshots were not retained with the acceptance artifacts. A later remediation retains parseable content-addressed exports and supersedes these implementation findings without rewriting this historical fail disposition.

blocking_findings.title: Production acceptance does not authenticate product-owner event provenance
blocking_findings.detail: _validate_acceptance_bindings accepts an approval object from decision/revocation/candidate/review/gate fields only. It does not resolve approval_event or root_owner_delegation, verify raw-export bytes, verify the exact user-message hash, enforce event chronology, or consume the event once. The production integration control intentionally uses a bare approval object with no provenance and passes. This violates FR3 and the inherited candidate/acceptance ordering contract.
blocking_findings.remediation: Create a new gate version whose production accepted-manifest validator resolves and validates the owner event through the event adapter, add forged/replayed/earlier-event mutation tests at the supervisor boundary, then obtain fresh independent review and owner approval for the changed gate bytes. The current approval cannot authorize that post-approval gate change.

blocking_findings.title: Mandatory reviewer fork isolation is unproved
blocking_findings.detail: The inherited role contract requires each receipt to record fork_turns and requires independent reviewers to use fork_turns=none; missing runtime attestation fails closed. The accepted review records schema-field-absent and the plan nevertheless marks the fork_turns=none task complete. Distinct session and chronology are useful but are not the required context-isolation attestation.
blocking_findings.remediation: Repeat independent review on a collaboration surface that exposes and attests fork_turns=none, or obtain an explicit product specification amendment before generating a new accepted manifest.

blocking_findings.title: Accepted collaboration provenance is not independently replayable
blocking_findings.detail: At audit time the artifacts retained hashes and byte counts but not the exact raw export snapshots, so this audit could not inspect the exact bytes underlying role and owner provenance. Subsequent fresh reviewer, delegated-owner, and root-owner exports parse successfully.
blocking_findings.remediation: Retain immutable raw exports or a provider-verifiable content-addressed receipt at acceptance time, validate them through the adapter, and regenerate review/approval/accepted artifacts in a new gate version.
